english.title: Fail to comply with a condition specified in a museum firearms licence
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being

(A)_[the person]_
(B)_[one of the persons]_

responsible for the management of a museum, namely **(..SPECIFY MUSEUM..),

(C)_[failed]_
(D)_[caused **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to fail]_
(E)_[permitted **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to fail]_

to comply with a condition, namely **(..SPECIFY CONDITION..), specified in the museum firearms licence held in respect of that museum
english.legislation: Contrary to paragraph 4(1)(b) and (2) of the Schedule to the Firearms (Amendment) Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
failed to comply OR
caused / permitted a person to fail to comply
with condition of museum firearms licence

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: In proceedings against any persons for an offence under this section it is a defence for the defendant to prove that he or she took all reasonable precautions and exercised all due diligence to avoid the commission of the offence.
